QuestInfo.name: Find the Puppet
QuestInfo.0: This is your third assignment as an informant and you're at #b#m102000000##k with #p1103004#, investigating the causes of the #o1140130#s' erratic behavior. You should talk to #b#p1103004##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1103004# tells you that the #o1140130#s' erratic behavior was definitely caused by a puppet, but the puppet is not necessarily on the #o1140130#s' bodies. It could be somewhere outside... You should search the #bPile of Relics#k in #b#m102020500##k and find the #b#t4032319##k.\n\n#i4032319# #t4032319# #b#c4032319# / 5#k
QuestInfo.2: You retrieved all of the #t4032319#s. #p1103004# seemed genuinely shocked that the puppets were used for such a purpose and told you she'd have to write a report on this. A report? What report?

0.0: I am quite certain the puppet plays a part in the #o1140130#s' strange behavior. This detector shows the force of darkness emanating from the puppet and displays it on the screen. If the puppet was inside the #o1140130#s, then it would have been moving, but look, it's not moving at all.
0.1: That means the Puppet is somewhere around the #o1140130#s, but not necessarily being carried by them. Near the #m102020500#, you'll see a #bPile of Relics#k lying around. Maybe the kid hid the Puppet in there.
0.2: In order to stop the #o1140130#s from being violent, we'll have to defeat them all and retrieve the Puppet. Your task right now is to head over to the #b#m102020500##k, blast all the Piles of Relics, and find the #t4032319#s. The monitor shows that there are #b5#k Puppets out there. Please retrieve them all.

yes.0: You do know how to break apart a pile of relics, right? Just use a #bregular attack#k on it, and the pile will crumble.\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Eh...? You don't want to do it? I already gave #p1002104# a reward for helping me out and all...

1.0: Wow, you managed to find all the #t4032319#s in the area. Okay this is going straight into the report.

yes.0: I have to deal with the fallout from this incident. Can it wait?

item.0: You have yet to find #b5 #t4032319#s#k? Find a #bPile of Relics#k at #m102020500# and break it apart using #bRegular Attack#k to find the #t4032319#s.
